question: How many checkouts were billed to the United States in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkout WHERE bill_nation = 'US' AND checked_out_at >= '2020-01-01' AND checked_out_at < '2021-01-01'
note: Stored as 'US' (shown in the sample values), not 'USA' or 'United States'.

question: What is the total amount spent by members whose home country is Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(k.amount) FROM checkout k JOIN member m ON m.member_id = k.member_id WHERE m.nation = 'Brasil'
note: Stored as 'Brasil' (shown in the sample values).

question: Which staff members work in the IT team? Give their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT given_name, family_name FROM staff WHERE role_title IN ('Systems Lead', 'Systems Technician')
note: The roles are 'Systems Lead' and 'Systems Technician' (all role values are in the schema summary); nothing says 'IT'.

question: How many catalog items are in the hip hop / rap style?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_item i JOIN style s ON s.style_id = i.style_id WHERE s.style_label = 'Urban / Rap'
note: Stored as 'Urban / Rap', which the schema summary does not show; LIKE '%hip%hop%' finds nothing.

question: How much revenue came from checkouts billed to the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM checkout WHERE bill_nation = 'GB'
note: Stored as 'GB', not shown in the summary (only the 3 most common nations are).

question: How many catalog items are in the heavy metal style?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_item i JOIN style s ON s.style_id = i.style_id WHERE s.style_label = 'Metal (Classic)'
note: Heavy metal is stored as 'Metal (Classic)'; a separate 'Metal' style also exists, so LIKE '%metal%' returns a wrong non-zero count and no retry fires.

question: For each customer advisor, what is the total revenue from the members they look after? Show the advisor's name and the total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT s.given_name, s.family_name, SUM(k.amount) AS revenue FROM staff s JOIN member m ON m.advisor_id = s.staff_id JOIN checkout k ON k.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY s.staff_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which 5 creators earned the most revenue from checkouts billed outside the US and Canada? List them from highest to lowest.
gold_sql: SELECT cr.creator_name, SUM(l.price_each * l.qty) AS revenue FROM checkout_line l JOIN checkout k ON k.checkout_id = l.checkout_id JOIN catalog_item i ON i.item_id = l.item_id JOIN collection c ON c.collection_id = i.collection_id JOIN creator cr ON cr.creator_id = c.creator_id WHERE k.bill_nation NOT IN ('US', 'Canada') GROUP BY cr.creator_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many different members have bought at least one item from a collection by Iron Maiden?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.member_id) FROM checkout k JOIN checkout_line l ON l.checkout_id = k.checkout_id JOIN catalog_item i ON i.item_id = l.item_id JOIN collection c ON c.collection_id = i.collection_id JOIN creator cr ON cr.creator_id = c.creator_id WHERE cr.creator_name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: For each home country, which member has spent the most? Show the country, the member's name and their total.
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.given_name, m.family_name, m.nation, SUM(k.amount) AS spent FROM member m JOIN checkout k ON k.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY spent DESC) AS rk FROM t) SELECT nation, given_name, family_name, spent FROM r WHERE rk = 1
note: Three GB members tie for the top; all three must be kept.

question: Show the revenue for each calendar year and a running total across the years, in year order.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(checked_out_at, 1, 4) AS yr, SUM(amount) AS revenue, SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY substr(checked_out_at, 1, 4)) AS running FROM checkout GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

question: Which catalog item is the third longest? Give its title and its length in seconds.
gold_sql: SELECT item_title, duration_sec FROM catalog_item ORDER BY duration_sec DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
note: Lengths are stored in whole seconds (duration_sec), not milliseconds.

question: What was the total revenue in the first half of 2019, January to June?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM checkout WHERE checked_out_at >= '2019-01-01' AND checked_out_at < '2019-07-01'
note: Timestamps carry a time of day (09:30), so BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-06-30' drops the checkout on 30 June.

question: How many checkouts happened in the third quarter of 2019?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkout WHERE checked_out_at >= '2019-07-01' AND checked_out_at < '2019-10-01'
note: Two checkouts fall on 30 September at 09:30.

question: How many members made their very first checkout in 2017?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, MIN(checked_out_at) AS first_at FROM checkout GROUP BY member_id) WHERE first_at >= '2017-01-01' AND first_at < '2018-01-01'

question: Who was the top-spending member in 2019?
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT m.given_name, m.family_name, SUM(k.amount) AS spent FROM checkout k JOIN member m ON m.member_id = k.member_id WHERE k.checked_out_at >= '2019-01-01' AND k.checked_out_at < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_id) SELECT given_name, family_name FROM t WHERE spent = (SELECT MAX(spent) FROM t)
note: Two members tie on 1856.25; LIMIT 1 keeps only one of them.

question: Which shelf contains the most items? Give its id and title.
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT s.shelf_id, s.shelf_title, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shelf s JOIN shelf_item si ON si.shelf_id = s.shelf_id GROUP BY s.shelf_id) SELECT shelf_id, shelf_title FROM t WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM t)
note: Shelves 1 and 8 are both titled 'Music' and both hold 3290 items.

question: How many members are not located in California?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE province IS NULL OR province <> 'CA'
note: 29 members have no province; province <> 'CA' alone skips them and gives 27 instead of 56.

question: Which staff members do not manage anyone? Give their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT given_name, family_name FROM staff s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staff r WHERE r.manager_id = s.staff_id)
note: staff_id NOT IN (SELECT manager_id FROM staff) returns nothing, because manager_id contains a NULL.

question: For each file format, how many catalog items have no credits listed? Include every format, even when the count is zero.
gold_sql: SELECT f.format_label, COUNT(i.item_id) FROM file_format f LEFT JOIN catalog_item i ON i.format_id = f.format_id AND i.credits IS NULL GROUP BY f.format_id
note: The 'aac' format has no uncredited items; an inner join drops that row.
